resolution.note: Stop check reads the repo contract (base, related, full fallback, guard); name-match and go-package selection; deleted files, no-relation fall-through and crash fail-open closed; proven on real pytest (uvx) and go 1.27.3 fixtures; krn hook entry carried to t-d25znwp

title: The worker Stop check and related-test selection run any stack's tests from the repo contract
body:
Why: in a foreign repository the Stop check finds no test/*.test.ts and allows without running anything (scripts/claude/worker-stop.ts:27,98,136); hooks are repo scripts adopt never installs (.claude/settings.json:36-128).
Outcome: the Stop check reads the repo contract (base, related command, full test fallback); related selection keeps the JS import graph and adds a name-match selector for other stacks, falling back to the full test command; hooks run as `krn hook <name>` from the installed binary.
Proof: Stop check unit tests on a pytest fixture repo (red refuses, green commit allows) and a go fixture; KRN's own Stop check behaviour unchanged.
Scope: scripts/claude/, src/repo/, src/cli/, test/.

Add a contract field guard: whole-tree invariant tests the Stop check always runs (KRN: test/rules and evals freeze tests). Evidence: dev-k4 547 605 617 passed their hidden tests but broke test/rules/capture-privacy-guard, host-path-guard and evals fr40-freeze, which the related-test selection never runs.

Logic audit fail-open cases to close here: worker-stop.ts:117 --diff-filter=d drops deleted files so tests importing a deleted module are never selected; :225 a change no test imports allows at once (must fall back to the full or guard command); an exception in judgeStop exits 1, which Claude Code treats as non-blocking (must fail closed with exit 2).
